Small follow-up to 2026.10.04.1: one logic fix and a rewritten README. No configuration changes are needed.

### Fix
- **Date conversion helper.** It now turns a date-and-time into a plain date. Dates set in the UI were never affected; this only guards the every-n-days start date against other inputs.

### Documentation
- **Rewritten README.** It's now a compact guide covering supported schedules, installation (including HACS as a custom repository), configuration, the sensor, services, manual update, blueprints and a dashboard example. The outdated "end of support" notice, duplicated sections and old badges are gone, and the examples use the current automation syntax.
- **Blueprint links point to this repository.** That covers the import links and each blueprint's `source_url`, so re-importing a blueprint pulls it from here.
- **Donation links removed.** The "Buy me a coffee" page (`info.md`) and the sponsor button (`FUNDING.yml`) are gone. HACS now shows the README.

### Unchanged
- Odd/even and every-n-weeks schedules keep following ISO week numbers, including across a New Year after a 53-week year.
